Revenue in 2024 Q3 was **$8,461,841.81**.

The **Midwest decline** was mainly caused by **Halloway Group not renewing at the end of the previous quarter**. The review says Halloway was the Midwest region’s largest account by revenue, and its departure was the single largest driver of the decline. It also says the loss was attributed to **a competitor’s national framework agreement**, not service failure.
